fixes.target: photo-1: Electrical distribution system before and after explosion
fixes.value: Two photos side by side of an electrical distribution cabinet fixed to a brick wall. The left photo shows the intact cabinet with its door open, with red, yellow and blue cables running to the switchgear and a green emergency exit-style sign on the door. The right photo shows the same kind of cabinet after an explosion, with the inside blackened and scorched and the cables burnt.
fixes.reason: Photo pair is clearly before and after, matching the target title; no readable printed labels apart from a small sign on the door.
fixes.evidence: Left: intact grey cabinet, coloured cables, open door. Right: charred, blackened cabinet interior.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.value: A photo of a small wooden site cabinet with two red doors open, standing on grass in front of a brick wall. Inside are two grey boxes fixed to a plywood back panel: a larger one with a printed label and a smaller one with a clear lid, each with black cables running down from the bottom. The label on the larger box is too small to read.
fixes.reason: Photo of a site intake cabinet matching the target title; the small label text is not legible.
fixes.evidence: Red doors open, two grey enclosures with black cables, grass and brick wall behind.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.target: figure-3: A secure, lockable battery charging point
fixes.value: A photo of two columns of blue metal lockers with round lock handles and ventilation slots, standing against a wall. Two of the lockers in the middle rows have their doors open, and the inside of one shows a small device fixed to the door. A grey wire-mesh locker stands to the left, and a no-smoking sign is on the door behind, with the printed name "elliott".
fixes.reason: Photo of lockable battery charging lockers matching the target title; only the printed word on the sign is readable.
fixes.evidence: Twelve blue lockers in two columns, two open; mesh locker at left; sign reading elliott.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.target: figure-4a: An example of bad practice – tape
fixes.value: A close-up photo of a distribution board with rows of black circuit breakers, where red, blue, brown and green-and-yellow striped tape has been stuck across many of the breakers. Handwritten paper labels sit beside the breakers, and a label at the top left reads "TEMP SITE POWER". Yellow stickers are on the right edge.
fixes.reason: Photo of a board covered in tape, matching the bad-practice title; most handwriting is not legible.
fixes.evidence: Coloured tape strips over breakers; handwritten label reading TEMP SITE POWER.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.target: figure-4b: An example of good practice – use of a
fixes.value: A photo of a distribution board with two banks of circuit breakers, taken in dim light. Red lock-off devices with padlocks are fitted over breakers on the left and right banks, and a yellow caution tag hangs from the right padlock. Below the breakers is a main switch with a printed "MAIN SWITCH" label and the text "ISOLATE BEFORE REMOVING".
fixes.reason: Photo of a board with breaker lock-off devices matching the good-practice title; the caution tag text is only partly legible.
fixes.evidence: Red lock-off clips with padlocks, yellow tag, main switch labelled MAIN SWITCH.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.value: A photo of temporary electrical distribution equipment on a construction site. A red wall-mounted distribution box with a warning sign and a printed name sits on a metal frame in the middle. A smaller red-topped unit with a clear front is on the left and a red and yellow unit is on the right. Black cables and yellow cables run between them across a concrete floor.
fixes.reason: The image is a colour photo with no printed labels or numbers inside it. The printed word on the red box is hard to read, so I only describe it as a name.
fixes.evidence: Photo shows a red box on a stand, a unit on the left, a yellow and red unit on the right, and yellow and black cables on a concrete floor.
